baseline_final_aggregation.real: one baseline forecast run per frozen final real series
baseline_final_aggregation.seasonal_naive: create comparison rows only when frozen seasonal period m > 1
baseline_final_aggregation.synthetic: one baseline forecast run per process x DGP-seed x noise condition; compute metrics for that condition, then arithmetic mean across the three confirmatory noise levels to obtain one process x DGP-seed analysis unit

failure_and_estimability.failure_reporting: Failures and failure rates are reported separately by model/domain and are never replaced, imputed, or silently substituted.
failure_and_estimability.pairwise_accuracy: A paired accuracy comparison is formed only when both PC-NFPSO and the comparator have estimable values for the same frozen analysis unit.
failure_and_estimability.pc_nfpso_optimizer_replicate_requirement: All five required optimizer replicates must succeed with finite predictions and finite metric values for the PC-NFPSO metric of a synthetic condition or real series to be estimable. Do not compute a median from a surviving subset.
failure_and_estimability.real_baseline_requirement: The baseline run must succeed for that real series.
failure_and_estimability.synthetic_baseline_block_requirement: All three confirmatory noise-condition baseline values must be estimable before forming that baseline's process x DGP-seed analysis-unit value.
failure_and_estimability.synthetic_pc_block_requirement: All three confirmatory noise-condition PC-NFPSO aggregates must be estimable before forming the process x DGP-seed analysis-unit value.

real.metric_aggregation_within_series: median across the five optimizer-replicate metric values

synthetic.metric_aggregation_within_process_seed_n: median across the five optimizer-replicate metric values

scope.role: performance-blind implementation clarification before any final forecast is generated

title: Final stochastic aggregation and secondary-metric operationalization

trigger.reason: The frozen protocol specifies five final optimizer seeds and defines the real confirmatory analysis unit as one series, but does not explicitly state how stochastic PC-NFPSO replicates are reduced to one real-series metric. It also names sMAPE and RMSSE without fully operationalizing their numerical formulas.
